_comment: Replayed by shared/src/__tests__/openclaw-approval.test.ts and apple/AgentDeckTests/OpenClawApprovalErrorTests.swift. `gone` means the Gateway told us the approval no longer exists, so the prompt must be abandoned rather than re-offered. Strings are the Gateway's own (src/infra/approval-errors.ts + approval-shared), read from the installed openclaw package, not invented here.

vectors.name: legacy message — the one this fleet actually produced (2026-09-09 23:40:37)
already resolved — another operator answered first
ambiguous id prefix — the approval EXISTS, the id was short

error.message: ambiguous approval id prefix; use the full id

vectors.name: transport failure — we do not know anything about the approval
RPC timeout — silence is not an answer
a decision the request forbids — the approval is still pending
details that is not an object cannot carry a reason
